wiki.title: Jay C. Block
wiki.extract: Jay Christopher Block (born November 9, 1970) is an American politician. A member of the Republican Party, he has been in the New Mexico Senate since 2025. Block was previously a member of the Sandoval County Commission from 2016 to 2024. He lost the Republican primary for New Mexico governor in 2022.
